answer: New identities start at zero influence and earn capability one step at a time, like a lotus opening petal by petal: each tier needs a task graded by auditors. Registration roots each identity in one funding source, like yarrow in one soil, and locks a 150 POA bond that slashes in full on a failed grade. Each identity also solves a sequential puzzle needing 6 hours of single-thread CPU. Clusters sharing a funding source cannot vouch for each other, and graders flag answers that whisper the same phrasing. One fake costs 150 POA and 6 CPU-hours; 1,000 cost 150,000 POA and 6,000 CPU-hours.
